environment: Linux Chromium headless with SwiftShader software WebGL;1280×900 and1024×768 emulated touch. NOT real iPad or Safari.

Exact sole clipping preserves original cut/hole edges: full-source-no-exclusion

assumptions: The AI source does not possess paper-compatible topology. The displayed shoe side is explicitly replaced with this complete, paper-owned independent panel before detach animation.
Flat rest shape, cut boundary and eyelet topology come from the existing calibrated paper mesh; the original AI triangles remain a separate source asset.
Visible source cloth constrains a robust smooth depth field; samples are not pinned through occlusion discontinuities. Other vertices are same-layer inferred completions.
The traced lower pencil line is only a provisional default exclusion. Full-paper and photo-inferred diagnostic variants remain available; no physical sole cut is certified.
Every analytic circular crease target is rest-metric regularised using the same material topology; adjacent samples form a continuous animation, not a validated cloth/contact simulation.
Physical sewing, exact hidden wrap, actual model scale and self-intersections remain unverified.

Crease normals are regularised toward the explicitly assumed analytic fold orientation to prevent opposite local branches and interpolation collapse; no recovered manufacturing/contact process is claimed.

checks.name: Actual evaluator returns exact canonical paper endpoint
All same-topology unfold key poses are finite and nondegenerate

attachedMetric.warning: Relative to assumed uniform model display scale. Not a validated physical cloth law or manufacture.

limitations: Physical sole-wrap boundary, hidden folds, model scale and material strain are unverified.
An exact numerical paper endpoint is not a certified real-world flattening result.
Software WebGL timing does not establish physical iPad GPU performance.
